title: OS command execution via system (awk) — review required
description: The awk sink system launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via getline pipelines.
remediation: Use getline pipelines with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any system call matches. Other languages' launchers are separate rules.
